Bug_Details:
Testing an object for equality with itself will always be true. The arguments to equals method are the same object, so it always returns true.
Either change the arguments to point to different objects or substitute true. For test cases, instead of explicitly testing equals, use
EqualsTester from Guava.

Since 'this' refers to the object itself, the 'equals' method always returns true, causing the test to pass even though it should fail.
